summary: Reorganizes G-code editing and inspection into full-height workspaces and broadens command recognition.
warning: Installed post packages, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Inspection recognizes more command families, but recognition does not mean controller execution is simulated. Unknown control flow, unsupported motion and ambiguous numeric blocks can now omit preview fragments that older inspection drew. Controller-specific labels retain their dialect or exact-post scope; the preview remains nominal XY only.

checklist.schema: App version advances once to 0.0.696. UPID, post, package, engine API and persisted storage schemas are unchanged. Ephemeral inspection snapshots can report an unsupported plane.
checklist.events: Execution-event contracts, compilation and post invocation are unchanged. Broader inspection command definitions explicitly distinguish preserved motion, suspended continuation and unknown position.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capability claims and WebMCP contracts are unchanged. Arbitrary numeric G/M commands remain inventoried; common probing, motion, coordinate, path-control and machine-control families gain scoped descriptions without inventing unsupported geometry.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Post audit, generation and exact output serialization remain authoritative. Inspection does not rewrite text or regenerate output for a download. Existing editable-import cleanup, line operations, save, undo and normalized export are preserved.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration, package rewrite, saved-revision mutation or cleanup. Browser-cache, temporary and folder persistence paths are unchanged. Layout choices do not alter project content.
checklist.verification: Independent implementation and final-delta review pass. Final integrated regression run: 210 suites / 2,098 tests pass. Complete Chromium run: 89 pass, one existing externally seeded-workbench case skipped; includes desktop and compact layouts, keyboard/focus, scrolling to source/settings/actions, retained drafts, editable save/reload/normalized export, standalone exact source, UPID layouts and exact fresh/saved controller artifact inspection/download with unchanged cache. Production TypeScript/build, 27 documentation pages / 87 checked files, generated post-contract parity and STEP source distribution pass. All three unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation pass. Existing behavioral assertions are preserved; obsolete drawer/layout/copy expectations exercise replacement views. One initial timing-limit failure passes unchanged in focused and final full runs.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged post passes all three conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation. Native installation, generation, fresh/saved inspection and exact download equality pass; pinned command/context details remain read-only. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: G-code workspaces give code, preview and details room to work.
changes: Machine Programs use full-height Lines, Text, Summary and Points tabs, with a wider resizable code pane and a Code/Preview switch on smaller screens.
The shared inspector keeps source beside one full-height Preview, Line, Commands, Issues or Context view. Small screens show one focused view with reachable paging and controls.
Preview assumptions move into Context. Source selection, command and issue navigation, exact export context and downloads remain linked to the inspected text.
More common G/M command families have scoped descriptions. Unsupported motion and ambiguous blocks explicitly limit the preview instead of inheriting an earlier move.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts and generated bytes are unchanged. Some inspection previews intentionally omit more uncertain motion. Recognition is not a controller execution guarantee.
publicNotes.action: Use Inspect G-code for quick standalone or export review, and Open Machine Program for an editable copy. In inspection, choose Context for preview settings and Issues for interpretation limits.
